paragraphs.text: Active exploitation of Cisco vulnerabilities added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog and a critical unauthenticated privilege escalation in Zoom Workplace for Windows demand immediate vulnerability and access management review. Concurrent third-party breaches at Baker Tilly, ScreenConnect MSP environments, and Fireworks AI infrastructure expose supply chain and data protection gaps. Certificate authority eMudhra revoking intermediate CA certificates and N-able taking its N-central RMM platform offline after 33 flaws add identity trust and change management urgency.

Control owners should prioritize asset identification for CISA KEV-listed Cisco products, verify Zoom Workplace updates across all endpoints, assess MSP monitoring coverage for ScreenConnect compromise indicators, review third-party assurance for Baker Tilly and Fireworks AI dependencies, confirm eMudhra certificate reissuance for affected services, and validate N-able hotfix deployment with rollback evidence.
